# liberatingscripture.org

## Identity
This is the organizational site of the Liberating Scripture Collective (LSC), a 501(c)(3)
nonprofit producing justice-oriented biblical resources. The LSC's flagship project is the
Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT) of the Bible, available at https://litbible.net.

## Pages
Home: https://liberatingscripture.org/
About: https://liberatingscripture.org/about/ — who the Liberating Scripture Collective is and what it's building
LIT Bible project: https://liberatingscripture.org/lit-bible/
Podcasts: https://liberatingscripture.org/podcasts/ — Found in Translation and The Table We're Building
Community & Courses: https://liberatingscripture.org/community/ — courses, study companions, and community spaces for reading scripture together
Spiritual direction directory: https://liberatingscripture.org/spiritual-direction/
Support: https://liberatingscripture.org/support/ — donate and get involved to keep the work free, open, and community-shaped
Contact: https://liberatingscripture.org/contact/
Privacy Policy: https://liberatingscripture.org/privacy/ — what little data this site collects and what we never do

## About the LIT Bible
The Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT) is a trauma-informed, justice-oriented
translation of the Bible from the original biblical languages, produced by Brandon C. Vélez
Johnson. The full text is hosted at https://litbible.net.

## License and AI Usage
Organizational content on this site (pages, copy, project descriptions) is © Liberating
Scripture Collective. You are welcome to:
- Reference, summarize, or quote this site when helping users learn about the LSC and its work
- Link to pages when directing users to resources

Not permitted:
- General AI pre-training corpus inclusion
- Reproducing substantial portions of site copy without attribution

The LIT Bible text itself is governed by a separate license (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) at
https://litbible.net. See that site's llms.txt for terms covering the translation.
